mathematics.assertion_tested: For specified finite synthetic cold-barotropic Cowling systems, Omega=h*exp(-nu)*(W1*V2-V1*W2) is constant to reported floating-point tolerance within smooth phases and continuous across current slow/rapid interface maps. An independently integrated center-outward/surface-inward weighted determinant is stable across five match radii.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE double precision, NumPy/SciPy floating point.
mathematics.conventions: State order [W,V]; bilinear determinant without complex conjugation; inner-to-outer transfer orientation; signature (-+++); r in m; h in J m^-3; chi dimensionless.
inputs: Smooth synthetic phase: r=[1200,7200] m, chi=0.37, nu_prime=2e-6 m^-1, ell=2, f=1200 Hz, 201 sample radii, complex independent fundamental columns, DOP853 rtol=2e-12.
Two-sided synthetic phase: same radial domain, ell=2, f=1350 Hz; center-outward and surface-inward integrations; matching radii 1800,3100,4700,6200,7200 m; DOP853 rtol=2e-12, max_step=100 m.
Exact slow/rapid synthetic 2x2 maps; ell trace tests 1,2,3,5 by exact matrix exponential.
Negative controls: chi_ad != chi_eq, artificial lapse jump, unlimited max_step.
